item.title: El papa León XIV recibe el alta médica y regresa al Vaticano tras su operación de pulmón
item.description: Cuatro días después de someterse a una cirugía para la extirpación de un tumor cancerígeno en el pulmón derecho, el papa León XIV ha recibido el alta médica y dejó este sábado el hospital Gemelli de Roma. Su reaparición pública será este domingo, cuando impartirá el tradicional ángelus frente a la Plaza de San Pedro. Si bien restan conocerse los resultados de los análisis del nódulo extraído, la buena evolución alimenta las expectativas de una recuperación con miras a su esperada gira por América Latina. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Isabel Allende wins €1m Spanish literary prize under pseudonym
item.description: Chilean-American author awarded Premio Planeta for sequel to her 1982 debut novel, The House of the Spirits The Chilean-American author Isabel Allende has won Spain’s €1m (£843,000) Premio Planeta, one of the world’s most lucrative literary prizes, under a pseudonym, with a sequel to her celebrated debut novel, The House of the Spirits. Allende, 84, won the 75th edition of the award on Thursday with La hora antes del alba , which returns to the characters of her 1982 novel, a multigenerational family saga set against political upheaval in a country inspired by Chile. item.title: Asean climate monitor issues highest alert level over toxic haze
item.description: Ongoing fires in Indonesia that have blanketed parts of Southeast Asia with toxic haze have triggered the highest-level alert by the regional bloc’s climate and fire monitor. “Activation of Alert Level 3 for the Southern Asean region,” the Singapore Asean Specialised Meteorological Centre (ASMC) said on its website, seen on Saturday.
